title: Keeping the Love Tank Full
coreMove: Treat felt love as emotional fuel, not mood decoration: name the tank level, stop confusing provision with affection, and refill security before asking conflict to carry the marriage.

exampleSpecs.stakes: avoid treating an empty tank as character failure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: start with the emotional tank before discipline
stop using possessions as a replacement for affection

exampleSpecs.audience: spouses trying to report emotional need
exampleSpecs.stakes: make low love discussable without accusation
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: turn a low number into a repair request

exampleSpecs.stakes: name emotional hunger without denying risk
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: connect risky behavior to unmet love

exampleSpecs.stakes: separate rejection from an empty tank signal
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: name the emotional gap before arguing about sex

exampleSpecs.audience: couples entering a tense money talk
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: check the tank before solving the issue
